comment: #1363 done criterion (tools/architecture/session_method_index.py check). Non-forward inherent WorldSession methods in crates/wow-world/src/session/** may remain only when allow-listed here by name: the runtime shell and the world-server construction API (the original groups), and, since slice 12d, the bootstrap/identity steps, the #169 money fences, the #754 single writer, the mailbox pump, the session context builders (split, hub-field and many-field, each labelled by what it reads), the session logic over the quest reward context, and the rest-bonus cfg(test) fixture seams that stay for good (measured in the final cleanup); every entry outside the two original groups carries a one-line reason in `reasons`. The staying set is bounded, the outside ratchet is 0 (check --done), and crate_ceiling bounds the whole crate so logic cannot leave session/** for handlers/ unseen. Entries are paths relative to crates/wow-world/src: a trailing '/' is a directory, 'file::method' is one method; every entry must match a non-forward method.

reasons.session/visibility/operations.rs::sync_r: driver phase step: called by session/driver and the visibility host impl; the visibility split forward stays so the driver's staying lines do not grow.

Stays permanently.
